sections.title: A parking bay of flat land

items.q: What is Chongqing actually short of?
items.a: Not towers. **Flat ground.** Central hills **90%+**. **17 m²** per person — one parking bay. Then 10,000+ towers, **~600 km** rail, **7,000 km** roads.

items.q: What do ordinary cities do with a steep slope?
items.a: A long approach bridge. Chongqing **coils the road**. One clip is a **720°** spring bridge. The title joke is the packing problem.

items.q: Why would 盘龙 need 48 ramps?
items.a: Eight directions, pairwise links. [[merge-overlapping-ramps]]: connect one turn, **merge any overlap**. Result: five decks, **40 m ≈ 13 floors**, **18** ramps. Two exits each. U-turn on the bottom.

items.q: What is 苏家坝 if 盘龙 is the merge exam?
items.a: The height rhyme. A **360°** climb of **72 m ≈ 24 floors**. Same leftover-land craft, taller stack.

sections.title: Occupy the building, isolate the shake

items.q: How does a monorail go through 李子坝?
items.a: [[isolate-the-through-rail]]. **150 × 20 m** leftover. Three-storey void. **Guideway off the building frame.** Rubber tires + air springs. Plant + concourse: **7–19 dB**.

items.q: What does 'my 1st floor is your 22nd' mean?
items.a: [[elevator-as-public-downhill]]. 魁星楼: roof plaza + skybridge. A private core becomes a **civic downhill** on the **>200 m** 渝中 drop.
[[coexist-dont-fight-the-mountain]]. **没得啥子对着山.** 共息, 共存, then 共生. Keep the site's charm and the assigned function.

items.q: How does the hill look flatter without being cut down?
items.a: [[stacked-land-missions]]. One plot, many jobs — hub + mall + office + highway + park. **Every inch reused.** 山地自有山地的路.
